Lead SDET | Playwright | C#/.NET, Java, Python or TypeScript | Global Payments & Banking Company 
Location: Bucharest, hybrid
Permanent, full-time role
 Our long-standing client, an international payments and banking group, is bringing testing in house. At the moment their QA is outsourced to a consultancy, and they’re now building their own QA function in Bucharest. They want a Lead SDET in first to shape it. You’ll be the first hire in a team of around nine automation engineers, and you’ll set the technical direction for everyone who joins after you.
 This is an architect-level, hands-on technical leadership role. You’ll report to the Head of QA, who handles people management, with a dotted line to the Bucharest site lead. You’ll own the test architecture and automation standards across their US bank and payments programmes, and help shape how the rest of the team is hired. Their automation runs in silos across five to ten internal and external systems, and you’ll design the framework that brings it together while staying hands-on in Playwright. They’re open to strong engineers from C#/.Net, Java, Python or TypeScript/JavaScript backgrounds.
 Non-Negotiables 
Playwright
Financial services: payments, SWIFT, banking or FX
8+ years in QA/SDET, including technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code and mentoring engineers
Test automation framework design across integrated systems
C#/.NET (NUnit) preferred. Java, Python or TypeScript/JavaScript also considered.
SDET background, hands-on coding
CI/CD: building YAML pipelines in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
API testing: Postman, code-based API suites, contract and schema testing
SQL for data validation
Test evidence and traceability in a regulated environment
MCP (Model Context Protocol): working knowledge, or able to pick it up quickly
 What You’ll Work With 
C#/.NET, with some TypeScript – (open to other languages)
Kafka, Azure Service Bus and RabbitMQ
Azure Application Insights, KQL
Azure, Kubernetes (K8s), Docker
IaC: Terraform
Web apps and legacy Windows desktop apps
GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry
Azure DevOps, TestRail, Jira
 Nice to Haves 
AI in testing: agentic workflows, AI-assisted test generation, LLM evaluation
Load testing at high transaction volumes: k6, Gatling, JMeter, Artillery, LoadRunner
Service virtualisation, mocks, stubs
Payments standards: ISO 20022, SEPA Instant, B2B payments
Platforms: Temenos, Dynamics 365, SmartTrade, Backbase
Microsoft Entra ID for test automation: OAuth 2.0 token flows, managed identities
BDD: Gherkin, SpecFlow, Cucumber
Working with third-party or nearshore QA partners
Moving a team from manual testing to automation
ISTQB Foundation
 Why Join / Projects 
 We’ve worked with this client for several years and placed people across their tech teams. They’re an international business with a strong reputation in payments, and this is one of the more interesting builds we’re recruiting for in Bucharest.
You’re building the function rather than inheriting one. You’ll set the framework and the standards, help hire the team, and shape the engineering culture of a growing tech hub.
You’ll design a test pyramid weighted towards fast API, contract and integration checks, with quality built in from discovery through to production verification.
You’ll create one framework and centre of excellence across both sides of the business, payments and banking, so you see the whole estate rather than one product.
They’re building a template for agentic engineering across the software lifecycle, with QA as one of its pillars. You’ll help decide where AI fits into testing and set the guardrails for it.
 Employee Benefits 
25 days’ holiday plus Romanian public holidays
Extra day off in your birthday month
Private medical cover
Annual salary review
Support for training and study
Long service awards
